answer_text: If all active links have unacceptable SLA and remedies don’t resolve the issue, the Socket will connect to a different PoP. It starts an initial connectivity SLA evaluation period of up to 40–50 seconds. The SLA evaluation period is 40 seconds and is checked every 10 seconds, so the evaluation completes in roughly 40 seconds (with timing variances up to about 50 seconds).
